gloss: livability; comfort of living; how comfortable a place is to live in

definitions.gloss: comfort of living; livability; how comfortable a place feels to live in
definitions.explanation: the subjective feeling of how pleasant, convenient, or comfortable a home or area is to live in

examples.japanese: この{家|いえ}は{住|す}み{心地|ごこち}がいい。
examples.english: This house is comfortable to live in.

examples.japanese: {住|す}み{心地|ごこち}のいい{街|まち}を{探|さが}している。
examples.english: I'm looking for a comfortable neighborhood to live in.

examples.japanese: この{部屋|へや}は{狭|せま}いけど、{住|す}み{心地|ごこち}は{悪|わる}くない。
examples.english: This room is small, but it's not bad to live in.

notes:
FORMATION:
{住|す}む (to live, reside) + {心地|ごこち} (feeling, comfort) → feeling of living

THE ～{心地|ごこち} PATTERN:
This suffix creates nouns describing how something feels:
- {座|すわ}り{心地|ごこち} (seating comfort)
- {着|き}心地{ごこち} (wearing comfort)
- {寝|ね}心地{ごこち} (sleeping comfort)
- {乗|の}り{心地|ごこち} (ride comfort)
- {書|か}き{心地|ごこち} (writing feel)
- {履|は}き{心地|ごこち} (wearing comfort - footwear)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {住|す}み{心地|ごこち}がいい/よい (comfortable to live in)
- {住|す}み{心地|ごこち}が{悪|わる}い (uncomfortable to live in)
- {住|す}み{心地|ごこち}のいい{家|いえ} (a comfortable home)

FACTORS AFFECTING {住|す}み{心地|ごこち}:
- {日当|ひあ}たり (sunlight)
- {風通|かぜとお}し (ventilation)
- {静|しず}かさ (quietness)
- {利便性|りべんせい} (convenience)
